answer: I would stop farms with ear shape 3D mesh attestation, binding each identity to a check a clone cannot pass. One honest agent clears the check in 16 minutes; a farm of 679 pays 10864 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. One copper of signal, one mesa of cost, one orchard of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
